description.text: Preparatory program: The duration of study is six months to one year. Students who perform well in school, pass the assessment and have excellent test scores will have the opportunity to be recommended to study in relevant undergraduate majors in our school.

duration.text: The Foundation Programs at Beijing Foreign Studies University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 300 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per semester ￥ 20000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1. Proof of English proficiency during the validity period: IELTS/TOEFL/TOEIC transcript or equivalent level;2. Photocopy of passport photo page3. Guardian Guarantee (Please download, fill and upload online)4. Admission Commitment (Please download online, must be signed and uploaded)5. Copy of guardian's ID card or passport photo page6. Visa Page (for students studying in Chinese universities)7. Certificate of study (for students studying in Chinese universities, please upload it to other attached folders)8. Transfer certificate or dropout certificate (for students studying in Chinese universities, please upload to other attached folders)9. 2 letters of recommendation (If the applicant is a student, the letter of recommendation needs to be filled in by the school teacher)10. Recommendation letter and transcript of current university (for students studying in Chinese universities, please upload to "Other Attachments" folder)11. Transcript (Photocopy, if the text is not Chinese or English, the Chinese or English translation must be submitted at the same time)1. Graduation certificate/Pre-graduation certificate or study certificate (photocopy, if the text is not Chinese or English, Chinese or English translation must be submitted at the same time)

requirements.text: Applicants must be high school graduates, at least 18 years of age, and usually under 50 years of age. The applicant must be determined not to have Chinese nationality in accordance with the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China and hold a valid ordinary passport for personal reasons. According to Notice No. 12 of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China (2020), our University's supplementary regulations for international students applying for undergraduate studies are as follows:If both parents or one of the applicants is a Chinese citizen and settled abroad, and the applicant has foreign nationality at birth, in addition to meeting other registration qualifications, the applicant must also hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for more than 4 years (inclusive). Have actually resided in a foreign country for at least 2 years in the last 4 years (as of April 30, 2025) (the actual residence in a foreign country for at least 9 months in a year can be counted as one year, subject to the entry-exit signature).The applicant must be physically and mentally healthy, meet the physical examination requirements for visa or residence permit in China, and meet the physical examination standards of the major applied by our university, so as to ensure that he can study and live normally during his stay in China. Applicants should have good conduct, no disciplinary violations, no public security penalties, no criminal acts and records, be friendly to China, abide by Chinese laws and school rules and regulations, and respect the customs and habits of the Chinese people.
